To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) test data selection for Boolean specifications can be based on fault types; (ii) test data generation can be performed by a fault based approach; and (iii) two strategies of test data selection for the detection of two special types of faults have been proposed.

(1) the test data selection problem can be solved by generating test cases for all possible faults in the Boolean expression being tested, (2) the test data generation problem is NP-hard in the strong sense, and (3) the test data problem can be solved using an approximation approach.
two test data selection strategies for Boolean specifications are discussed and the strategies guarantee the detection of two types of faults.

the generation of test data to detect the occurrence of faults in software represented as Boolean expressions.
